cross_references.relationship: state parallel — §550 applies to all CA-regulated insurers without interstate commerce requirement; §1347 applies to health care benefit programs affecting commerce. Both apply to Blue Shield. Can be charged concurrently. Federal prosecution carries heavier penalties; state prosecution is faster and more accessible.

civil rights companion — if Blue Shield is a Medicare Advantage contractor acting under color of federal program authority, and denial of benefits causes constitutional injury (e.g., denial of necessary care implicating liberty/property interest), §1983 may reach the denial. Courts split on whether private Medicare Advantage contractors act 'under color of law.' This is a contingent cross-reference.

qui tam companion — if Blue Shield submitted false claims to CMS for Medicare Advantage capitation while denying covered services, FCA qui tam (31 U.S.C. §3729) provides treble damages + relator share. Not yet built as standalone standard.
cross_references.build_status: NOT BUILT AS STANDALONE STANDARD — FCA not yet in corpus; cross-trigger documented here
